effectiveness.proposition: hari's evolution surfaces a concrete upgrade path for Demerzel: (1) Subjective Logic as a richer 'Unknown' state with calibrated uncertainty + base rate, (2) belief provenance chains, (3) trust-weighted multi-agent voting. The 'demote Lie / promote simpler baseline' pattern is itself a methodological lesson Demerzel should internalise.
